title: Wrong email or password
meaning: Firebase rejected the email/password pair (or no such account).
userFix: Re-type both carefully, or use Forgot password. Students use the student sign-in; non-Babson emails use Guest access.
staffCheck: Confirm which sign-in they used. Check Firebase Console → Authentication → Users for the email.

title: Sign-in required
meaning: The request reached the server without a valid sign-in.
userFix: Sign in and try again.
staffCheck: If they ARE signed in, have them sign out and in again; check the device clock.

title: Session expired
meaning: Their sign-in token was rejected as expired or invalid.
userFix: Sign out, sign back in.
staffCheck: If it repeats for everyone, check FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON belongs to the same Firebase project as the app/site config (BR-SRV-002).

title: Recent sign-in needed
meaning: Deleting an account requires a sign-in from the last 5 minutes.
userFix: Enter your password when asked, then try deleting again right away.

title: Email not verified
meaning: The action needs a verified email address.
userFix: Open the verification email, click the link, then tap 'I've verified'. Check spam.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users shows verified status. Resend from the app or website.

title: Too many attempts
meaning: Firebase temporarily blocked this device after repeated failures.
userFix: Wait about 15 minutes, or reset the password.

title: Sign-in failed (other reason)
meaning: Firebase returned an error we don't have a specific code for.
userFix: Try again; if it repeats, send us the code and what you were doing.
staffCheck: Check the browser console / Xcode log for the raw Firebase error code.

title: Email sign-in is turned off
meaning: Email/Password is not enabled in Firebase (auth/operation-not-allowed).
userFix: Nothing you can do; contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method → enable Email/Password.

title: This website address isn't authorized
meaning: The domain isn't in Firebase's authorized list (auth/unauthorized-domain).
userFix: Nothing you can do; contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains → add the domain (babsonradio.com, www., and any .vercel.app).

title: Account disabled
meaning: The account was disabled in Firebase.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users → re-enable.

title: Signed in, profile did not load
meaning: The app signed in with Firebase but could not load the account from the server.
userFix: Close and reopen the app, then try again.
staffCheck: Check /api/health (admin-only) and the Vercel logs for /api/me. The app must send X-Preview-Key while the site is locked.

title: Firebase rejected the developer sign-in
meaning: The server accepted the password but Firebase would not sign the app in with the token.
userFix: Try again in a minute.
staffCheck: The iOS GoogleService-Info.plist and the web/server Firebase project must be the same project (babson-radio). Check Authentication is enabled.

title: Babson email required
meaning: Student sign-up/sign-in needs a @babson.edu address (or a guest used a Babson address).
userFix: Use your @babson.edu email for student accounts; use Guest access with any other email.

title: Email already has an account
meaning: An account with this email already exists.
userFix: Sign in instead, or use Forgot password.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users.

title: Phone number already registered
meaning: Another account already uses this phone number.
userFix: Sign in to the existing account. If it isn't yours, contact the station.
staffCheck: The number is stored encrypted, so you cannot search for it. The phoneIndex document id is the phoneHash of the owning account (its uid is inside). Never share who it is with the requester.

title: Invalid phone number
meaning: Not a valid 10-digit US number.
userFix: Enter 10 digits, e.g. (617) 555-0123.

title: Password problem
meaning: Password too short/long (8–128 characters) or too weak.
userFix: Use at least 8 characters.

title: Name missing
meaning: First name is required.
userFix: Enter your first name.

title: Delete confirmation missing
meaning: The delete request didn't include the confirmation.
userFix: Use the Delete my account button and enter your password.

title: Profile not found
meaning: The sign-in exists but its profile record is missing.
userFix: Sign out and back in. If it repeats, contact the station.
staffCheck: Compare Authentication → Users with Firestore users/{uid}. A failed sign-up can leave Auth without a profile; delete the Auth user so they can re-register.

title: Invalid email address
meaning: The email isn't formatted correctly.
userFix: Check for typos.

title: Sponsor not found
meaning: No verified Babson student with that email is registered.
userFix: Check the spelling; the student must have created and verified an account.
staffCheck: Look up users where email == sponsor email and check emailVerified in Authentication.

title: Sponsor is at the guest limit
meaning: A student can sponsor up to 10 guests at once.
userFix: Ask the student to revoke an old pass.
staffCheck: Limit is MAX_ACTIVE_GUESTS_PER_STUDENT in lib/guest.ts.

title: Too many guest requests today
meaning: Guests can send 5 sponsor requests per 24 hours.
userFix: Try again tomorrow.

title: End-of-semester not configured
meaning: No upcoming semester-end date.
userFix: Pick 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days.
staffCheck: SEMESTER_END_DATES in Vercel (MM-DD,MM-DD). Defaults to 12-18,05-14 if unset.

title: Guest access not needed
meaning: Students already have full access.
userFix: Sign in with your Babson account.

title: Guest trial or pass ended
meaning: Live access has run out.
userFix: Ask a Babson student to sponsor you.
staffCheck: Check guestTrials/{uid} and guestPasses/{uid}.

title: Contact sync limit reached
meaning: Contact matching is limited to 5 times per day.
userFix: Try again tomorrow.

title: Contact data problem
meaning: The contact list sent was empty or too large.
userFix: Update the app and try again.
staffCheck: Max 5000 hashes per sync.

title: Time not allowed
meaning: Air-time requests must start 24h–60 days ahead, 15–240 minutes long, on a 15-minute mark.
userFix: Pick a time that fits those rules.
staffCheck: Rules live in lib/slots.ts.

title: Time already booked
meaning: Another approved slot overlaps.
userFix: Pick a different time.
staffCheck: Check airSlots for the time range.

title: Too many pending requests
meaning: Limit of 3 pending requests per person.
userFix: Wait for a decision or cancel one.

title: Request can't be changed
meaning: It was already decided, cancelled or started.
userFix: Refresh the list.

title: Request details missing or invalid
meaning: Title, category, type or audio link is missing or invalid (audio links must be https and only for pre-recorded shows).
userFix: Fix the highlighted fields.

title: Verification or permission needed
meaning: The action requires a verified Babson account.
userFix: Verify your @babson.edu email.

title: Staff only
meaning: The action is limited to staff or the owner.
userFix: Ask a staff member.

title: Invalid request
meaning: The server couldn't use what was sent.
userFix: Check the form and try again; update the app if it repeats.

title: Not found or already handled
meaning: The item doesn't exist or was already dealt with.
userFix: Refresh and try again.

title: Rate limit
meaning: Too many requests too quickly.
userFix: Wait a minute and retry.

title: Unexpected server error
meaning: Something failed that we haven't classified.
userFix: Try again. If it repeats, send the code AND the 'ref' number.
staffCheck: Search Vercel → Logs for the ref value; the full error is printed next to it.

title: Server key missing
meaning: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON isn't set on the server.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables → add it, then redeploy. Check /api/health (admin-only, or send the x-health-key header).

title: Server key malformed
meaning: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON isn't valid one-line JSON or the key is wrong.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Regenerate the key, convert to ONE line (json.dumps), paste with no extra quotes, redeploy.

title: Server secret missing
meaning: PHONE_HASH_PEPPER is missing or under 16 characters.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Set a random 32+ character value (openssl rand -hex 32) in Vercel and redeploy. Never change it later.

title: Database not created
meaning: Firestore has no database in this Firebase project.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Firestore Database → Create database.

title: Database index missing
meaning: A query needs a Firestore index.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: firebase deploy --only firestore:indexes (or open the link in the error log). Wait until the index shows Enabled.

title: Authentication not set up
meaning: Firebase Authentication isn't initialized for the project.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Get started → enable Email/Password.

title: Server not allowed to use the database
meaning: The service account lacks permission or belongs to a different project.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Regenerate the key from the SAME project (babson-radio); check IAM roles (Firebase Admin SDK / Editor).

title: Server couldn't reach Firebase
meaning: Network timeout or connection failure to Google services.
userFix: Wait a minute and retry.
staffCheck: Check status.firebase.google.com; usually transient.

title: Can't reach Babson Radio
meaning: The device is offline or the server didn't answer.
userFix: Check your internet connection and try again.
staffCheck: Sign in as an admin on the same device and open /api/health (it is admin-only).

title: App not connected to server
meaning: The iOS app's server address isn't set.
userFix: Update the app.
staffCheck: BackendConfig.baseURLString must be the live site URL, no trailing slash.

title: Sign-in not set up in this app build
meaning: The iOS build is missing Firebase or GoogleService-Info.plist.
userFix: Update the app.
staffCheck: Add the Firebase package and a correctly named GoogleService-Info.plist to the BabsonRadio target; clean build.

title: Unreadable server reply
meaning: The server answered with something the app couldn't understand.
userFix: Update the app and retry.
staffCheck: Compare app and website versions; check /api/health (admin-only).

title: Playback couldn't start
meaning: The stream didn't load.
userFix: Check your connection and try again.
staffCheck: Open the stream URL directly; check the Asura panel (source connected? bitrate/listener limit?).

title: Host controls are closed
meaning: Radio controls and the set list are open from 4 hours before a host's show until 4 hours after it.
userFix: Come back closer to your show time.
staffCheck: Check the show's day and times in Admin → Schedule, and the time zone in Auto-Scheduler. Developers and admins are never blocked.

title: Message blocked by the word filter
meaning: A show note or title matched the word filter at or above the allowed level.
userFix: Reword the text and send it again.
staffCheck: Levels and words are in lib/server/wordFilter.ts and lib/server/wordLists.ts; the strictness setting is in Admin > Blocked words.

title: Not a host of that show
meaning: The account is not listed as a host of that show.
userFix: Ask a station admin to add you as a host.
staffCheck: Admin → Schedule → edit the show → Host accounts (usernames). Approved student slots are linked to the student automatically.

title: Radio did not accept the command
meaning: The station software (AzuraCast) refused or did not answer the skip command.
userFix: Try again in a moment.
staffCheck: Check AZURACAST_URL / AZURACAST_API_KEY in Vercel, and that the API key's role has Manage Station Broadcasting.

title: Last name missing
meaning: Sign-up needs both a first and last name.
userFix: Enter your last name.
staffCheck: No longer used: sign-up does not ask for a last name.

title: Graduation year missing
meaning: Sign-up needs a graduation year (or Alumni / Faculty or staff).
userFix: Pick your graduation year from the list and try again.
staffCheck: No longer used at sign-up. Graduation year is optional and asked later in About you.

title: Terms not accepted
meaning: Creating an account requires agreeing to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
userFix: Tick the box that says you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, then try again.
staffCheck: None needed. Acceptance time and version are saved on the user's profile (termsAcceptedAt, termsVersion).

title: That school email can't be used here
meaning: An Apple account tried to set a school email that is on the owner list. Owner accounts have to sign up with the email directly.
userFix: Use a different school email.
staffCheck: If it is really the owner, they should sign up or sign in with that email and verify it. Check OWNER_EMAILS in Vercel.

title: Verify your email to keep using Babson Radio
meaning: The account is more than 7 days old and its email is still not verified, so the server only allows sign-in and verification calls. After 14 days an unverified account is deleted.
userFix: Open the verification email and click the link (check spam), or use Resend email on the verify screen. If the address is wrong, sign out and sign up again with the right one.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → check the Email verified column. The demo reviewer account is never locked. The nightly cleanup deletes unverified accounts after day 14 and logs them in accountDeletions.

title: Quick check needed
meaning: Sign-up looks busy or unusual right now (several sign-ups from one network, a burst across the site, or repeated failures), so the server asks for a Cloudflare Turnstile check. The iOS app passes with App Check instead.
userFix: Complete the check shown under the password box, then tap Create account again.
staffCheck: Normal on launch day on campus Wi-Fi. If the check never appears, NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY is missing in Vercel; if it always fails, check TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY and the widget hostname in Cloudflare.

title: Too many sign-ups right now
meaning: Sign-up hit a hard limit: a very large burst from one IP, one email domain, or the whole site in a minute, or a very large number of failures from one IP.
userFix: Wait a few minutes and try again.
staffCheck: Look for [signup blocked] in the Vercel logs: the reason says which limit (ip burst, ip day, ip failures, domain flood, site flood). Limits are in lib/signupLimits.ts.

title: Open Babson Radio from the app
meaning: The request had no valid Firebase App Check token. App Check proves the call comes from the real iOS app. Only enforced when APPCHECK_ENFORCE=1.
userFix: Update the app to the latest version and open it from the home screen. A jailbroken or emulated device will not pass.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → App Check → confirm the iOS app is registered with App Attest. If real users fail, set APPCHECK_ENFORCE empty to switch enforcement off.

title: That name isn't allowed
meaning: A first or last name contains a word on the blocked list (Admin Panel → Blocked words, plus the built-in lists).
userFix: Use a different name.
staffCheck: Look at the name the person was trying to use. If it is a real name that is wrongly blocked, check Admin Panel → Blocked words for a custom entry.

title: Under 13
meaning: The birthday or age range says the person is under 13. Babson Radio keeps no data about under-13s, so the account and everything on it was deleted.
userFix: Babson Radio is for people 13 and older.
staffCheck: Nothing is kept. Check the Firebase user is gone if the person disputes it.

title: Parent or guardian OK needed
meaning: People 13 to 17 must confirm a parent or guardian agrees to them using Babson Radio.
userFix: Tick the parent or guardian box, then continue.
staffCheck: None needed. The answer is saved as parentalConsent on the user's profile.

title: Birthday or age range missing or not valid
meaning: The birthday was not a real past date, or neither a birthday nor an age range was sent.
userFix: Pick your birthday, or tap 'use age range instead' and pick a range.
staffCheck: None needed. The app blocks this before the server is called.

title: Unknown setup step
meaning: The app asked about a setup step that does not exist.
userFix: Update the app and try again.
staffCheck: Valid steps: verifyEmail, name, avatar, birthday, gradYear, phone (lib/setup.ts). An old or modified client can send something else.

title: Step not part of this account
meaning: The step does not apply to this kind of account. Graduation year, phone number and Instagram are for students only; Guests never get them.
userFix: Nothing to do. Skip it.
staffCheck: Guests have no gradYear, phone or instagram step; if a Guest sees one, the app is out of date.

title: This step cannot be skipped
meaning: The email step is required and cannot be skipped.
userFix: Open the link in your verification email.
staffCheck: Only verifyEmail is required. Its deadline is emailDeadlineAt in the setup block of /api/me.

title: Month and day needed
meaning: The birth year sits on the 13 or 18 line, so the year alone cannot tell whether the person is old enough or an adult.
userFix: Add your month and day.
staffCheck: Only happens for a year-only birthday in the cutoff years. Nothing was saved.

title: Phone number already on the account
meaning: A number is already saved. Changing it needs an admin to approve it.
userFix: Use Profile > Phone number to ask for a change.
staffCheck: Changes go through /api/me/phone and Admin > Phone changes.

title: Finish this step from your email
meaning: The email step is completed by opening the verification link, not by saving a value.
userFix: Open the link in your verification email, then check again. Look in spam.
staffCheck: Firebase Console > Authentication > Users shows verified status. The app resends with sendEmailVerification.

title: Name missing
meaning: The name step needs a name.
userFix: Enter your name.

title: Avatar color not valid
meaning: The color is not one of the profile colors.
userFix: Pick one of the colors shown.
staffCheck: Valid ids are in lib/profile.ts (AVATAR_COLORS).

title: Babson campus line
meaning: The number is one of Babson's own lines (781-239), not a personal number. Nothing was saved.
userFix: Enter your own mobile number, or skip this step.
staffCheck: The blocked prefixes are BLOCKED_NUMBER_PREFIXES in lib/phone.ts (kept in step with blockedNumberPrefixes in ProfileView.swift). Contact lists drop these hashes too.

title: Instagram handle not valid
meaning: The text is not an Instagram handle or an instagram.com profile link. A handle is 1 to 30 letters, numbers, periods or underscores. Nothing was saved.
userFix: Type your handle like @name, or paste your profile link. Or skip this step.
staffCheck: Rules are in lib/instagram.ts (cleanInstagram). Handles are never checked against Instagram and need not be unique. An admin can clear one in Admin > People (logged in instagramClears).

title: Not an Apple sign-in
meaning: This step is only for accounts that signed in with Apple.
userFix: Sign out and sign in with Apple, or use the email sign-in.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Users: check the provider column shows Apple.

title: Encryption key missing
meaning: PII_KEY isn't set on the server, so birthdays and age ranges can't be stored encrypted.
userFix: Contact the station.
staffCheck: Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables → add PII_KEY (run: openssl rand -base64 32), then redeploy. Keep a copy: without it saved birthdays can't be read.

title: Public sharing blocked: someone under 18
meaning: A host or person in this content is under 18, so it cannot be made public. This is a minor-safety rule and cannot be overridden.
userFix: Leave it as students-only. Nothing else is needed.
staffCheck: Do not set visibility to public by hand for content with any under-18 host.

title: Age not on file
meaning: A host has not given a birthday or age range yet, so we cannot confirm they are 18 or older.
userFix: Open your profile and add your birthday or age range, then try again.
staffCheck: The user's profile needs onboardedAt and minor=false.

title: No known host
meaning: The episode has no linked host account, so ages cannot be checked.
userFix: Ask staff to add the host's school email to the episode.
staffCheck: Set hostUids on the episode (host emails in Admin > Library content).

title: Signature incomplete
meaning: Public sharing needs every box ticked and a full name typed.
userFix: Tick all the boxes and type your first and last name.
staffCheck: The signed record is saved in publicConsents with the agreement version and time.

title: Not your episode
meaning: Only the host named on an episode can sign to make it public.
userFix: Ask the host to do it from their Host page.
staffCheck: Check hostUids on the episode.

title: Training required
meaning: A student tried to request a slot without being certified.
userFix: Take the host quiz at /training, or request in-person training.
staffCheck: Admin > Training shows who is certified. Directors can certify by hand.

title: Quiz retried too fast
meaning: A second quiz attempt came within 20 seconds of the last.
userFix: Read the explanations, then try again.

title: Quiz not finished
meaning: Some questions were left blank.
userFix: Answer every question before submitting.

title: Conduct agreement not signed
meaning: The conduct agreement needs every box ticked and a typed full name.
userFix: Tick every box and type your first and last name.
staffCheck: Signed records are in conductConsents (kind=conduct).

title: Clean-hours pledge not signed
meaning: A slot that overlaps 6 AM to 10 PM Eastern needs the signed clean-hours pledge.
userFix: Sign the pledge, or pick a time outside the clean hours.
staffCheck: Signed records are in conductConsents (kind=clean); the request stores cleanPledgeId.

title: Contacts were checked recently
meaning: Contact suggestions can be refreshed once a day per account.
userFix: Try again tomorrow.
staffCheck: Nothing to fix. The limit is MIN_GAP_MS in lib/contactLimits.ts.

title: Verify your school email first
meaning: Contact matching only works for accounts whose school email is verified. The 7-day grace period does not count.
userFix: Open the verification email we sent to your school address and click the link, then try again.
staffCheck: Firebase Console → Authentication → Email verified column for this user.

title: Contacts already synced today
meaning: Matching contacts can be done once a day per account.
userFix: Try again tomorrow.
staffCheck: Nothing to fix. The limit is MIN_GAP_MS in lib/contactLimits.ts.

title: Too many new contacts this month
meaning: No error is shown for this: once an account has sent about 5,000 different numbers in 30 days, further new numbers are ignored. Numbers sent before still work.
userFix: Nothing to do; the limit resets as old numbers age out after 30 days.
staffCheck: A real contact list is almost never this big. A sweep of arbitrary numbers is what this stops. NEW_HASH_CAP in lib/contactLimits.ts.

title: Contacts are paused for this account
meaning: A sync looked like someone checking lots of numbers (a very high number of matches, or most of a big list matching), so contacts are paused until an admin clears it.
userFix: Contact Babson Radio if you think this is a mistake.
staffCheck: Admin Panel → Phone lookup → Paused accounts. Look at the reason and the account. Clear it if it is a real student with a big friend list. Thresholds: FLAG_MATCHED and FLAG_RATIO in lib/contactLimits.ts.

title: Pick a date range
meaning: The play log or another report needs a valid start and end date.
userFix: Choose both dates (end on or after start).

title: Date range too long
meaning: The play log is limited to 93 days at a time.
userFix: Export in smaller chunks.

title: Unsubscribe link didn't work
meaning: The unsubscribe link is damaged, or the account no longer exists.
userFix: Open the link again from the email. If it still fails, reply to the email and we will remove you.
staffCheck: Tokens are signed with LAUNCH_SECRET. If that was changed, old links stop working.

title: Launch email isn't set up
meaning: RESEND_API_KEY or LAUNCH_SECRET is missing on the server.
staffCheck: Set RESEND_API_KEY, MAIL_FROM and LAUNCH_SECRET in Vercel and redeploy.

title: Launch test email was refused
meaning: Resend did not accept the test email.
staffCheck: Read the reason in the error. Common: the sending domain is not verified in Resend, or the free plan's daily limit is used up.

title: Radio training ended
meaning: The radio badge ran out (it ends each June 30) and a new live show was requested.
userFix: Come to a training session to renew. Shows already approved stay on the schedule.
staffCheck: Admin > Studio roster shows the expiry. A director or admin can extend it by hand with a reason.

title: Training session not found
meaning: The session id does not exist, or the trainer is not a Director or Admin.
userFix: Pick a session from the list.
staffCheck: A session needs a Director or Admin as its trainer to be created or opened. Check the trainer's level in Admin > Users.

title: Verify your school email
meaning: Studio training needs a verified school email, not just the 7-day grace period.
userFix: Open the verification email, or resend it from your profile.

title: Trainer only
meaning: Only the named trainer (or an Admin) can open or close check-in, see the code, remove people and confirm. Only an Admin can name another trainer.
userFix: Ask the trainer, or an admin.
staffCheck: Check trainerUid on the trainingSessions document.

title: Check-in not open
meaning: Check-in is not open, the session is over, or it closed itself 15 minutes after the end.
userFix: Ask the trainer to open check-in.
staffCheck: Status checkin_open is needed. It auto-closes at endsAt + 15 minutes. A closed session can be reopened until then.

title: Too many tries
meaning: More than 5 check-in tries in a minute.
userFix: Wait a minute and try again.
staffCheck: Counted per person in trainingCheckinGuard.

title: Check-in locked
meaning: 10 wrong codes in a row locked check-in for 15 minutes.
userFix: Wait 15 minutes, then enter the code shown on the trainer's screen.
staffCheck: Wrong codes and the lock are in trainingCheckinLog. Delete the person's trainingCheckinGuard document to unlock them.

title: Already checked in
meaning: This person already checked in to this session.
userFix: Nothing to do. Wait for the trainer to confirm.
staffCheck: One check-in per person per session.

title: Removed from session
meaning: The trainer removed this person from the session.
userFix: Ask the trainer.
staffCheck: removedAt is set on the trainingAttendance row.

title: Session full
meaning: The session has no spots left.
userFix: Pick another session.
staffCheck: Capacity is checked when saving a spot (rsvpCount on the session).

title: Wrong check-in code
meaning: The code did not match the current or previous 30-second code.
userFix: Type the code exactly as shown. It changes every 30 seconds.
staffCheck: Logged in trainingCheckinLog. Ten wrong codes lock check-in for 15 minutes.

title: Close check-in first
meaning: Attendance can be confirmed only after check-in is closed and someone has checked in.
userFix: Close check-in, then confirm.

title: Staff do not check in
meaning: Directors and admins skip training, so they do not check in.
userFix: Nothing to do.

title: Attendance not confirmed
meaning: The quiz and agreement open only after the trainer confirms this person attended this session.
userFix: Ask the trainer to confirm attendance.
staffCheck: Look for confirmedAt on trainingAttendance/{sessionId}_{uid}. A removed person never gets it.

title: Studio first
meaning: Radio training needs a Studio badge already held, or granted by the same session.
userFix: Take Studio training first (or a session that covers both).
staffCheck: Check studioTrained and studioExpiresAt on the profile.

title: Quiz not finished
meaning: Some quiz questions were left blank.
userFix: Answer every question before submitting.

title: Quiz retried too fast
meaning: A second quiz attempt came within 20 seconds of the last.
userFix: Read the explanations, then try again.

title: Agreement not signed
meaning: The agreement needs every box ticked and a typed full name. Nothing is granted until it is signed.
userFix: Tick every box and type your first and last name.

title: Already confirmed
meaning: A confirmed person cannot be removed from the session.
userFix: Ask a director or admin to revoke the badge instead.
staffCheck: Revoke from Admin > Studio roster.

title: Reason too short
meaning: Revoking or granting by hand needs a typed reason of at least 10 characters.
userFix: Type a reason.
staffCheck: The reason is stored on the grant.

title: Grant not found or already revoked
meaning: The grant id is wrong, or it was revoked before.
userFix: Refresh the roster.
staffCheck: Grants are never edited or deleted, only revoked.

title: Cannot train this account
meaning: Guests cannot be trained and directors and admins do not need badges.
userFix: Verify a school email first.
staffCheck: Check the level in Admin > Users.

title: Enter a valid email
meaning: The email step on /studioaccess got something that is not an email address.
userFix: Type your email address and submit again.
staffCheck: Nothing to check.

title: Training form not available
meaning: No Studio form link is saved in Admin > Studio form and STUDIO_FORM_URL is not set (or is not a Microsoft Forms link).
userFix: Try again later and tell a Babson Sound officer.
staffCheck: Paste the form link in Admin > Studio form (or set STUDIO_FORM_URL in Vercel).

title: Too many tries today
meaning: One IP address opened the training form email step more than 25 times in a day.
userFix: Try again tomorrow.
staffCheck: Counters are in the studioAccessIp collection (they expire after 2 days).

title: Form link not accepted
meaning: The link saved in Admin > Studio form is not an https Microsoft Forms link.
userFix: Nothing for listeners to do.
staffCheck: Paste the form's share link (starts with https://forms.office.com or https://forms.cloud.microsoft).
